g.text: Customer signs in and reviews cart

Create one Transaction per vendor (multi-vendor cart)
Save reservation and item price snapshots

Create pending transaction and payment session
Store booking reference and available tracking details
Show paid order and delivery status

Do not mark order paid or request delivery

Transaction advances CONFIRMED → COMPLETED (direct, skips PREPARING/READY_FOR_PICKUP)

Update status (CONFIRMED → PREPARING → READY_FOR_PICKUP → COMPLETED / CANCELLED)
